rules.title: Security Deposit Limit
rules.requirement: Landlords may only charge up to one month's rent as a security deposit for both unfurnished and furnished units.

coverage.summary: Most residential rental units, with exemptions for certain small landlords.
coverage.owner_condition: Exempts landlords who own no more than two rental properties with a total of no more than four residential units.

rules.exemptions: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons.
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units

rules.title: Security Deposit Limit for Small Landlords
rules.requirement: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons.

coverage.summary: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons.
coverage.owner_condition: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC where all members are natural persons.

rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons

rules.title: Pre-Tenancy Unit Photograph Requirement
rules.requirement: For tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025, landlords must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document its condition.

coverage.summary: Tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025.
coverage.unresolvable: Tenancy start date on or after July 1, 2025

rules.quoted_span: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document the condition of the unit.

rules.title: Move-Out Walk-Through Inspection
rules.requirement: Landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy to identify items needing repair or cleaning, giving tenants a chance to correct issues before deductions are made.
rules.quoted_span: Under state law, landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy to identify any items that need repair/cleaning. This is to give tenants a chance to correct issues in order to avoid security deposit deductions.

rules.title: Allowed Security Deposit Deductions
rules.requirement: Landlords may only deduct from a security deposit amounts reasonably necessary to cover rent default, repair tenant-caused damage beyond normal wear and tear, clean the unit to its pre-tenancy level, or restore/replace personal property if allowed by the lease.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord may deduct only the amount that is reasonably necessary to: Cover rent default Repair damages caused by a tenant or a tenant's guest other than normal wear and tear Clean the unit to return it to the same level of cleanliness as at the start of the tenancy (for tenancies beginning after January 1, 2003)

rules.title: Professional Cleaning Deductions Restriction
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot charge tenants or deduct from security deposits for professional carpet cleaning or other professional cleaning services unless it is reasonably necessary to return the unit to its pre-tenancy condition, minus ordinary wear and tear.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord cannot require a tenant to pay for, or assert a claim against the tenant or the security deposit for professional carpet cleaning or other professional cleaning services, unless reasonably necessary to return the premises to the condition it was in at the start of the tenancy, minus ordinary wear and tear.

rules.title: Security Deposit Return Timeline and Itemization
rules.requirement: Landlords must return the security deposit within 21 days after the tenant vacates, providing an itemized written statement and supporting documents for any deductions, including proof of completed repairs starting January 1, 2025.
rules.quoted_span: All or any remaining portion of a security deposit must be returned within 21 days after the tenant/s leave the unit vacant. If deductions were made, the landlord must give the tenant a written statement itemizing the amount of and and purpose for any security deposit deductions, accompanied by copies of documents showing charges incurred and deducted by the landlord to repair or clean the premises, including a copy of any bill, invoice, or receipt for materials or supplies deductions.

rules.title: Post-Possession Photograph Requirement for Deductions
rules.requirement: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of the unit after regaining possession but before making repairs or cleaning for which they intend to deduct from the security deposit, and provide these photos to the tenant.

coverage.summary: All residential tenancies where landlords intend to make security deposit deductions for repairs or cleaning.

rules.quoted_span: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit. These photos and a written explanation of the cost of the repairs/cleaning must be given to the tenant along with the itemized statement.

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year, and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.

coverage.summary: Tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
coverage.unresolvable: Whether the unit is fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance

rules.exemptions: Units not covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
